title: Austin's Concessions, Power Plant Plans
summary:
*   **Auditorium & Coliseum Concessions:** City leaders reviewed a major concession contract for the Auditorium and Coliseum, outlining desired changes and terms for the agreement.
*   **Specific Concession Debates:** Key discussion points for the concession contract included rules for beer sales, acceptable drink containers (e.g., plastic vs. for seated service), accounting procedures, and managing outside concessions for special events like the Shrine Circus.
*   **Power Plant Land Acquisition:** Discussions centered on acquiring the Hart property to expand the Holly Street Power Station. No final decision was reached, with city officials opting to continue negotiations for the land.

Council Chamber, City Hall
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Miller presiding. Roll call: Present:
Councilmen Long, Palmer, Pearson, White, Mayor Miller Absent: None Present also: W. T.
Williams, Jr., City Manager; Doren R. Eskew, City Attorney The Mayor announced that this
meeting was called for the purpose of hearing a report of the City Manager on the meeting
he had with MR. EDDY JOSEPH and his Attorney regarding the contract for Concessions at the
Auditorium and Coliseum; and for the purpose of discussing the purchase of the Hart
Property for the Power Plant and Dam.
The City Manager submitted copies of the concession contract and pointed out the various
exceptions made. He went over each page of the contract in detail, and the Council
indicated the changes it wanted to make. Items discussed were the Shrine Circus with their
own concessions; the cancellation clause of the contract; giving away of foods and
beverages by leasees (demonstrations of food or advertisers); types of containers for
drinks (Plastic, except at seated affairs or where served at tables); price list for foods
and drinks to be served; vending in the stands; accounting procedures; relocating stands;
payments of taxes and fees; and the procedure for the sale of beer; insurance; and other
paragraphs of the contract.
The Council discussed the purchase of the Hart property in connection with the Holly
Street Power Station. The City Manager had maps of the area showing the property desired
and outlining the proposition the Harts had submitted to the City. No decision was made at
this meeting, and the City Manager was to negotiate further for the purchase of the
property.
There being no further business, the Council adjourned at 6:30 P.M., subject to the call
of the Mayor.
